name: The Arena
_why: Regenerated to the plot's own words (Clubhouse PR #30, Admin's verbatim comment): 'a room about as large as a high school gymnasium, but that looked like a library. In the middle of the ceiling was a gigantic swirling golden orb.' Kat and Nella 'jumped through the portal together' to get here from the Lounge — the plot never draws a door in this room at all, only the portal that brought you in. Redone to remove the plain doorway the old art had on its right wall (never called for by the plot) and to put the way out where the plot actually put the way in: a portal, at the near edge, the same red swirl as the Lounge's.
summary: A room as large as a high-school gymnasium that looks like a library: floor-to-ceiling dark wood bookshelves along the back wall, tiered wooden spectator stands rising along both side walls, and a wide expanse of smooth pale flagstone floor between them with two round raised wooden duelling platforms set well apart. An enormous cracked golden orb hangs from the very center of the ceiling above the bookshelves, blazing with intense magical light, with two long golden ribbon banners spilling down from the crack toward the floor.
floor: smooth pale worn flagstone in a plain grid, evenly lit, filling the entire frame edge to edge as a clean rectangle — no rug, no markings, no platforms (those are drawn separately)
_wall_why: A floor-plate room ships ONLY its floor, so the room's own back wall is a PROP and has to be generated like one. The wall has NO door in it anywhere — the plot's only way in or out of this room is the portal, which stands apart from the wall as its own freestanding prop near the front of the floor.
wall: a wide upright rectangular slab of floor-to-ceiling dark wood bookshelf packed with books, and NO door and NO opening

doors.look: the same red swirling stone-archway portal as the Lounge's, reused rather than redrawn so the two match exactly

contains: the SAME wide upright bookshelf wall slab as before, but with an ENORMOUS cracked golden orb hanging above it blazing with intense magical light, and two long golden ribbon banners spilling down from the crack toward the floor — still NO door and NO opening, only the bookshelf and the hanging orb
a tall tiered wooden spectator STAND, bench rows rising away from the viewer, seen square-on from the front, empty of any people
a round raised wooden duelling PLATFORM, seen from directly above, a simple flat drum shape with a low rim
